pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with rounded vertices and distinct edge gradients. The spatial area of individual patches is greatest on the mid-flank and reduces significantly in scale toward the posterior and lower limb regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored pathways separating the dark patches. The network features clearly defined junction nodes with relatively uniform pixel thickness throughout the visible torso.
